title: Thanksgiving Dinner for 10 Now Costs $58.63
sentence: The American Farm Bureau Federation's 2026 survey puts a classic Thanksgiving dinner for 10 at $58.63, up 6% from 2025 and the first increase since the 2022 record of $64.05; a 16-pound turkey costs $23.68, up 10%.
source: American Farm Bureau Federation, Thanksgiving Dinner Cost Ticks Upward in 2026 (Nov. 18, 2026): https://www.fb.org/intel/markets/thanksgiving-dinner-cost-ticks-upward-in-2026
High Plains Journal, Thanksgiving dinner costs rise 6% in 2026 (Nov. 18, 2026): https://hpj.com/2026/11/18/thanksgiving-dinner-costs-rise-6-in-2026-farm-bureau-reports/
